items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-30
items.q: That would be on Armstead Day... It has to be a great day Armstead Day.

ctx.x: Well no I went to one one or two big boats used to go on the excursion. I didn't know the name. It would be a special boat when they would have excursion. Going down to Chalmette. We had to go down to Chalmette. That would be on Armstead Day.

Yeah it's May the 30th. I wish that semester would still remain but it destroyed. Don't use it no more. It has to be a great day Armstead Day. Since it's May the 30th. And like September. First Monday in September used to be Labor Day. And during those days there used to be great days. But I had my old poor dad who was living them days. And he used to have to parade. Which is called the Long Charmette. Nobody would work harder. No working people would wake them days. That's way back. That's way back around 1914.…
